intro.headline: From product interfaces to production systems
intro.lede: I started in product UI, then followed the work into APIs, databases, and the pipelines that keep them shipping. Today I build CI/CD, containers, and cloud infrastructure so production stays boring.

story: I studied Computer Science & Engineering at Shahjalal University of Science and Technology from 2019 to 2024, graduating with a 3.52 CGPA. While finishing that degree I was already shipping: first as a Junior Web Developer at InnovexIT, building responsive appointment and workforce platforms in React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

From January 2024 to June 2026 I was a Front-End Engineer at Universal Machine Inc., working on a carbon credit platform for enterprise sustainability teams and on a Minipay wallet used by 200K+ people. That work spanned Next.js and TypeScript on the client, Node.js and PostgreSQL on the server, and GitHub Actions pipelines that test, lint, and deploy on every merge.

In 2023 I took blockchain systems into competitions and research — 1st runner-up at the Smart Village Idea Competition, a top-10 finish at the Bangladesh Blockchain Olympiad, and a paper at ICCIT on connecting landowners, farmers, and investors. The through-line is the same as my DevOps work: make systems that are transparent, automated, and hard to silently break.
